text: An emissary of the Shadow Council offers sealed rations in exchange for 30 men. The contract does not say what for.

left.label: Refuse
left.result: The emissary smiles and takes note. We will meet again.

right.label: Accept
right.result: The rations are good. Of the men, nothing more is heard.

text: An Imperium unit deserts after seeing one of the Winged fall near its trenches. They ask for asylum and bring their weapons.

left.label: Turn away
left.result: They go back. The Imperium does not forgive deserters.

right.label: Take them in
right.failResult: New recruits. And 10 metal gone from the unit's store.

text: In a bunker of the Concord a valve radio is still on. It repeats a call for peace recorded before the Fall.

left.label: Dismantle it
left.result: Valves and copper. The call falls silent.

right.label: Rebroadcast
right.result: Someone still believes. Volunteers arrive, for a while.

text: A convoy of the Great Houses crosses our territory. Fuel, and crates with the seal of an academy.

left.label: Let it pass
left.result: In gratitude they leave behind an armed escort.

right.label: Requisition
right.result: The fuel is ours. The Houses will remember.

text: The medical service proposes a serum made from Fragment dust. No one has tried it on a whole unit yet.

left.label: Store it
left.result: The vials stay in the depot. Labelled, just in case.

right.label: Distribute
right.result: The troops no longer sleep. Nobody asks why.
right.failResult: Half the unit in quarantine. Their skin has turned cold and glossy.

text: A violet frost settles on the front. The sentries swear they saw wings in the fog.

left.label: Hold position
left.result: The frost melts. The positions hold.

right.label: Advance into the frost
right.result: A squad of scouts comes out of the frost. No insignia, but our codes.

text: A Senate engineer is fleeing his own capital. In exchange for protection he offers to get our guns working again.

left.label: Refuse
left.result: He heads north. Someone else will take him in.

right.label: Protect him
right.result: An artillery piece is back in action overnight.

text: On the frequency of the Fall a woman's voice counts down. Then she says: «The Trial is not over.»

left.label: Ignore
left.result: Command files the message. The troops stay focused.

right.label: Follow the count
right.result: The count leads to a Concord depot buried under the ice. Inside, metal and silence.

text: In the archive of the Concord you find punched cards from a project: «Annunciation». Dated one year before the Fall.

left.label: Burn them
left.result: Some things are better not known. Morale rises.

right.label: Decode them
right.result: Among the cards, a map of depots. And a typewritten line: «We called them.»

text: An airship pilot has photographed the enemy lines from above. He wants metal, not promises.

left.label: Leave it
left.result: The airship climbs away with its plates.

right.label: Buy (15 metal)
right.result: The plates are sharp. Command grants the campaign one more minute.
